name: Ingredient class — oil-based supplements (fish oil/omega-3 and similar)
hazard_note: Fish-oil and marine-oil supplements carry a credible methylmercury pathway; methylmercury is measured on every lot. The child-protective limits are held and never relaxed for occurrence.
regulatory_floor_note: Dietary supplements are legally governed by an adult-oriented framework: FDA DSHEA sets no heavy-metal maxima; USP <2232> computes elemental-contaminant PDEs for an adult consumer; the food-supplement maximum levels several governments set (EU, GSO, Israel, Vietnam, Thailand, ASEAN, Singapore) are lax (lead 1000-10000, cadmium 300-1000, mercury 100-500 ug/kg). HMTc holds every supplement, adult- or child-labeled, to the strictest sovereign infant-and-child-food maximum level (Ages 0-5) by choice. The adult floor is disclosed on every cell and never selects the number.

Pb.analog_label: AU-NZ Standard 1.4.1 infant-formula lead maximum (the strictest sovereign infant lead ML)
Pb.label: Child-protective read-across from the strictest sovereign infant-and-child-food lead maximum (AU-NZ infant formula, 10 µg/kg). Adult supplement floors run 1000-10000 µg/kg (Thailand 1000; GSO/Israel/Vietnam 3000; ASEAN/Singapore 10000) and adult USP <2232> permits 5 µg/day (500 µg/kg at 10 g/day); California's developmental lead MADL is 0.5 µg/day. HMTc holds ALL supplements to 10 µg/kg because children consume adult supplements and lead has no threshold.
Pb.basis_note: child-protective read-across (voluntary over-compliance; adult floor disclosed, never selected)

iAs.label: Child-protective read-across from the strictest sovereign infant-and-child-food inorganic-arsenic maximum (EU infant formula, 10 µg/kg). No government sets an inorganic-arsenic supplement ML; adult USP <2232> permits inorganic arsenic 15 µg/day (1500 µg/kg at 10 g/day). HMTc holds ALL supplements to 10 µg/kg inorganic arsenic — 150x below the adult USP concentration floor.
iAs.basis_note: child-protective read-across (voluntary over-compliance; adult floor disclosed, never selected)

tAs.label: Child-protective read-across from the strictest sovereign infant-and-child-food total-arsenic maximum (India infant foods, 50 µg/kg). Total arsenic gates the inorganic-arsenic reflex; the toxic species iAs is anchored separately at 10 µg/kg. Adult supplement floors run 300-5000 µg/kg. HMTc holds ALL supplements to 50 µg/kg total arsenic.
tAs.basis_note: child-protective read-across (voluntary over-compliance; adult floor disclosed, never selected)

MeHg.rationale: Methylmercury is a component of total mercury (MeHg <= tHg). No in-force sovereign sets a separate MeHg maximum level for this product on its basis, so methylmercury is governed by and bounded by the total mercury ceiling (20 ug/kg); no separate MeHg ceiling is published. MeHg is speciated whenever tHg exceeds its reflex trigger.

Cd.analog_label: EU 2023/915 infant-formula cadmium maximum (the strictest sovereign infant cadmium ML)
Cd.analog_scope: infant formulae, follow-on formulae, food for special medical purposes intended for infants and young children, and young-child formulae placed on the market as liquid and manufactured from cow's milk proteins or cow's milk protein hydrolysates
Cd.label: Child-protective read-across from the strictest sovereign infant-and-child-food cadmium maximum (EU infant formula, 5 µg/kg). Adult supplement floors run 300-1000 µg/kg; adult USP <2232> permits 5 µg/day (500 µg/kg at 10 g/day); California's developmental cadmium MADL is 4.1 µg/day. HMTc holds ALL supplements to 5 µg/kg.
Cd.basis_note: child-protective read-across (voluntary over-compliance; adult floor disclosed, never selected)

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is a component of total chromium (Cr-VI <= Cr). No in-force sovereign sets a separate Cr-VI maximum level for this product on its basis, so hexavalent chromium is governed by and bounded by the total chromium ceiling (1000 ug/kg); no separate Cr-VI ceiling is published. Cr-VI is speciated whenever Cr exceeds its reflex trigger.

Ni.analog_label: EU 2024/1987 liquid infant/young-child-formula nickel maximum (the strictest sovereign infant nickel ML)
Ni.label: Child-protective read-across from the strictest sovereign infant-and-child-food nickel maximum (EU liquid infant/young-child formula, 100 µg/kg). No government sets a nickel supplement ML and adult USP <2232> sets none; the entire adult framework is silent on supplement nickel, a metal EFSA reports European diets already exceed the tolerable intake for, children most of all. HMTc holds ALL supplements to 100 µg/kg.
Ni.basis_note: child-protective read-across (voluntary over-compliance; adult floor disclosed, never selected)

Sn.analog_label: India FSSAI infant-food tin maximum (the only non-canned infant tin ML on the register)
Sn.analog_scope: Infant Milk substitute and Infant foods
Sn.label: Child-protective read-across from the India FSSAI non-canned infant-food tin maximum (5000 µg/kg). Tin is a can-migration analyte; a non-canned supplement has no intrinsic tin source, so any quantifiable tin triggers a packaging investigation. No adult supplement tin ML exists. HMTc holds ALL supplements to 5000 µg/kg.
Sn.basis_note: child-protective read-across (voluntary over-compliance; adult floor disclosed, never selected)

Al.label: Child-protective read-across from the AU-NZ non-soy infant-formula aluminium maximum (500 µg/kg) — the only government aluminium ML for any food in any jurisdiction. No adult supplement aluminium ML exists and USP <2232> sets none. HMTc holds ALL supplements to 500 µg/kg.
Al.basis_note: child-protective read-across (voluntary over-compliance; adult floor disclosed, never selected)
